words.enDefinition: press the alarm button to sleep a few more minutes

examples.en: I hit the snooze button three times before finally dragging myself out of bed.
examples.zh: 我「按了三次贪睡键」，才勉强从床上爬起来。

examples.en: If you keep hitting the snooze button, you will be late for your nine o'clock class.
examples.zh: 你再这样一直「按贪睡键」，九点的课就要迟到了。

words.enDefinition: make a loud sound, like an alarm ringing

examples.en: My alarm goes off at seven, but I never get up right away.
examples.zh: 我的闹钟七点「响起」，可我从来不马上起床。

examples.en: Did you hear my alarm go off this morning? It woke my whole floor.
examples.zh: 你听见我今天早上的闹钟「响」了吗？把整层楼都吵醒了。

collocations: my alarm goes off at six

words.enDefinition: choose a time for your phone or clock to wake you

examples.en: I set an alarm for 6:30 so I have time to eat breakfast.
examples.zh: 我「设了六点半的闹钟」，好留时间吃早餐。

examples.en: Before an early morning exam, always set an alarm on your phone too.
examples.zh: 早上要早起考试的话，记得在手机上「多设一个闹钟」。

collocations: set two alarms just in case

words.enDefinition: very early in the morning, just after sunrise

examples.en: The campus shuttle leaves at the crack of dawn, so set two alarms.
examples.zh: 校园班车「天一亮」就发车，所以记得定两个闹钟。

examples.en: We had to get up at the crack of dawn to catch the airport bus.
examples.zh: 为了赶机场大巴，我们只好「天一亮」就起床。

collocations: get up at the crack of dawn
leave at the crack of dawn
start at the crack of dawn

words.enDefinition: very early in the morning, often cheerfully or on time

examples.en: My roommate's alarm rang bright and early at six for her morning run.
examples.zh: 我室友「一大早」六点闹钟就响了，去晨跑。

examples.en: The movers said they would arrive bright and early on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 搬家公司说他们周六「一大早」就会到。

words.enDefinition: a cheerful way to tell someone to wake up

examples.en: Rise and shine! The dining hall stops serving breakfast in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 「快起床」！食堂再过二十分钟就停止供应早餐了。

examples.en: My dad always said rise and shine when he came to wake me up.
examples.zh: 我爸来叫我起床的时候，总会说一句「快起床」。

collocations: wake someone with rise and shine

words.enDefinition: someone who feels awake and energetic early in the day

examples.en: I'm not really a morning person, so I schedule my classes after ten.
examples.zh: 我不是「早起型的人」，所以把课都排在十点以后。

examples.en: My roommate is a morning person and goes for a run before breakfast.
examples.zh: 我室友是「早起型的人」，早餐前还要去跑个步。

collocations: a morning person or a night owl

words.enDefinition: a playful name for someone who sleeps too long

examples.en: Come on, sleepyhead, the campus shuttle leaves in ten minutes!
examples.zh: 快点，「小懒虫」，校园班车十分钟后就发车了！

examples.en: My older brother is such a sleepyhead that we always miss breakfast.
examples.zh: 我哥是个「小懒虫」，我们总是赶不上早餐。

words.enDefinition: feeling slow and half asleep when you just wake up

examples.en: I always feel groggy for the first ten minutes after my alarm rings.
examples.zh: 闹钟响后的头十分钟，我总是「昏昏沉沉的」。

examples.en: Skip the snooze button, because waking up slowly makes you groggier.
examples.zh: 别一直按贪睡键，醒来的过程拖得太久，只会让你更「昏昏沉沉」。

words.enDefinition: fully awake, with no feeling of sleepiness left

examples.en: A cold shower got me wide awake before my eight a.m. lecture.
examples.zh: 早八上课前，一次冷水澡让我「完全清醒」了。

examples.en: I was wide awake at midnight after drinking that bubble tea.
examples.zh: 喝了那杯奶茶之后，我半夜十二点还「清醒得很」。

words.enDefinition: begin your daily activities, usually in the morning

examples.en: I like to start my day with a quick shower and a coffee.
examples.zh: 我喜欢先冲个澡、喝杯咖啡，这样「开始一天」。

examples.en: Stretching for five minutes is a calm way to start the day.
examples.zh: 花五分钟拉伸一下，是平静地「开启一天」的方式。

collocations: a good way to start the day

words.enDefinition: wash, dress, and prepare yourself to leave

examples.en: Give me twenty minutes to get ready and then we can leave.
examples.zh: 给我二十分钟「收拾一下」，然后我们就能出发。

examples.en: She got ready for class in record time and still made coffee.
examples.zh: 她以最快速度「收拾好」准备上课，居然还煮了咖啡。

words.enDefinition: the set of things you do every morning

examples.en: My morning routine is simple: shower, coffee, and review my to-do list.
examples.zh: 我的「晨间流程」很简单：洗澡、咖啡，然后过一遍待办清单。

examples.en: A steady morning routine keeps me from forgetting my gym clothes.
examples.zh: 固定的「晨间流程」让我不会忘带健身服。

words.enDefinition: the usual things you do regularly every day

examples.en: Moving off campus completely changed my daily routine and my sleep schedule.
examples.zh: 搬出校园彻底改变了我的「日常作息」和睡眠时间。

examples.en: Try to keep a steady daily routine during exam week.
examples.zh: 考试周尽量保持稳定的「日常作息」。

collocations: fit workouts into my daily routine

words.enDefinition: quickly wash and tidy yourself, especially your face

examples.en: I stopped by the dorm just to freshen up before the seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨会开始前，我顺路回宿舍「梳洗了一下」。

examples.en: There's a restroom near the library entrance if you want to freshen up.
examples.zh: 如果你想「梳洗一下」，图书馆入口附近有洗手间。

words.enDefinition: clean your face with water and cleanser

examples.en: Splashing cold water to wash my face is how I wake up fastest.
examples.zh: 用冷水「洗脸」是我醒得最快的办法。

examples.en: Wash your face before bed so the pillowcase stays clean longer.
examples.zh: 睡前「洗把脸」，枕套就能久一点不脏。

collocations: wash my face with cold water

words.enDefinition: clean your teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste

examples.en: I brush my teeth right after breakfast so I don't forget.
examples.zh: 我早餐后马上「刷牙」，这样就不会忘。

examples.en: The dentist said to brush your teeth for two full minutes.
examples.zh: 牙医说每次要「刷牙」整整两分钟。

collocations: brush my teeth twice a day

words.enDefinition: put your clothes on after getting up

examples.en: I got dressed in five minutes and ran for the bus.
examples.zh: 我五分钟就「穿好衣服」，跑去赶公交。

examples.en: Get dressed first, and then we can figure out breakfast together.
examples.zh: 先「把衣服穿好」，然后我们再一起想早餐吃什么。

words.enDefinition: a set of clothes worn together for an occasion

examples.en: I picked a comfortable outfit for the long day of lectures.
examples.zh: 要上一整天课，我挑了「一身舒服的衣服」。

examples.en: She laid out her outfit for the presentation the night before.
examples.zh: 她前一晚就摆好了第二天演讲的「一身衣服」。

collocations: plan my outfit the night before

words.enDefinition: colored products people put on their faces

examples.en: She puts on a little makeup before her morning classes.
examples.zh: 她上早课前会化点「妆」。

examples.en: Remember to remove your makeup before you go to sleep.
examples.zh: 记得睡前「卸妆」。

words.enDefinition: make your hair tidy with a brush or comb

examples.en: I brush my hair while I wait for the kettle to boil.
examples.zh: 我一边等水烧开，一边「梳头发」。

examples.en: Brush your hair before you put on your bike helmet.
examples.zh: 戴自行车头盔之前，先「梳一下头发」。

collocations: brush and tie up your hair

words.enDefinition: use a comb to arrange your hair

examples.en: I comb my hair in the hallway mirror when the bathroom is busy.
examples.zh: 卫生间有人用的时候，我就在走廊的镜子前「梳头」。

examples.en: I always comb my hair again after walking through the wind on the way to campus.
examples.zh: 顶风走到学校之后，我总会重新「梳一下头」。

collocations: comb my hair in the mirror

words.enDefinition: tie your hair back with a band or clip

examples.en: I put my hair up when I'm cooking so it stays out of the way.
examples.zh: 做饭的时候我会「把头发扎起来」，免得碍事。

examples.en: Put your hair up before you wash your face at the sink.
examples.zh: 在水池边洗脸之前，先「把头发扎起来」。

collocations: put my hair up in a bun
put your hair up before bed

words.enDefinition: remove water from your hair with a towel or dryer

examples.en: I dry my hair while checking messages on my phone.
examples.zh: 我一边看手机消息，一边「吹头发」。

examples.en: Dry your hair fully before you go out in this cold wind.
examples.zh: 外面风这么大，出门前一定要把头发「吹干」。

collocations: dry my hair with a towel

words.enDefinition: tie the laces of shoes or boots

examples.en: Lace up your shoes quickly or we'll miss the campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 快点「系好鞋带」，不然我们要错过校园班车了。

examples.en: She laced up her running shoes and headed to the gym.
examples.zh: 她「系好跑鞋的鞋带」，朝健身房走去。

words.enDefinition: fasten the buttons on a shirt or coat

examples.en: Button up your coat, it's freezing on the walk to campus.
examples.zh: 走路去学校的路上特别冷，「把外套扣好」。

examples.en: He buttoned up his shirt properly for the career fair.
examples.zh: 为了参加招聘会，他把衬衫「扣得整整齐齐」。

words.enDefinition: push the edge of a shirt inside pants or a skirt

examples.en: The career center says tuck in your shirt for the networking night.
examples.zh: 就业指导中心说，求职社交晚宴上要「把衬衫塞好」。

examples.en: Tuck in the back of your shirt before you meet the advisor.
examples.zh: 见导师之前，「把衬衫后摆塞好」。

words.enDefinition: choose clothes that suit the day's temperature and conditions

examples.en: Check the forecast and dress for the weather before your morning walk.
examples.zh: 出门前看看天气预报，「按天气穿衣」。

examples.en: In this city you learn fast to dress for the weather, not the calendar.
examples.zh: 在这座城市，你很快就会学会「按天气穿衣」，而不是按日历穿。

collocations: dress for the weather in layers

words.enDefinition: arrive in time to board the bus

examples.en: If I leave by eight, I can catch the bus to campus.
examples.zh: 只要八点前出门，我就能「赶上公交车」去学校。

examples.en: She ran three blocks and still caught the bus with seconds to spare.
examples.zh: 她跑了三个街区，最后几秒还是「赶上了公交」。

words.enDefinition: arrive too late and fail to board the bus

examples.en: I missed the bus by one minute and had to walk to class.
examples.zh: 我「差一分钟没赶上公交」，只好走路去上课。

examples.en: Don't stay up late tonight, or you'll miss the bus again.
examples.zh: 今晚别熬夜了，不然你又会「没赶上公交」。

collocations: miss the bus by a minute

words.enDefinition: fail to get off at the right bus or train stop

examples.en: I was so sleepy that I missed my stop and ended up across town.
examples.zh: 我太困了，结果「坐过了站」，到了城另一头。

examples.en: Set a phone reminder so you don't miss your stop on the way back.
examples.zh: 设个手机提醒，免得回程「坐过站」。

collocations: miss my stop on the bus
missed my stop on the subway

words.enDefinition: leave a bus, train, or subway

examples.en: I usually get off two stops early to walk past the coffee shop.
examples.zh: 我通常「提前两站下车」，顺便路过那家咖啡店。

examples.en: You can get off at the library stop and cut through the quad.
examples.zh: 你可以在图书馆那一站「下车」，穿过草坪走过去。

collocations: get off at the next stop

words.enDefinition: a card or ticket letting you ride buses regularly

examples.en: The student bus pass costs less than paying each time you ride.
examples.zh: 学生「公交卡」比每次单独买票便宜。

examples.en: I lost my bus pass on Tuesday and had to pay cash all week.
examples.zh: 周二我把「公交卡」弄丢了，只好整整一周都付现金。

words.enDefinition: travel by underground train in a city

examples.en: I take the subway to campus because parking costs too much.
examples.zh: 我去学校都「坐地铁」，因为停车费太贵。

examples.en: We took the subway downtown and got there in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 我们「坐地铁」去市中心，二十分钟就到了。

words.enDefinition: a free or cheap bus that loops around campus

examples.en: The campus shuttle runs every ten minutes between the dorms and the library.
examples.zh: 「校园班车」每十分钟一趟，往返于宿舍和图书馆之间。

examples.en: I missed the last campus shuttle and had to walk home in the rain.
examples.zh: 我没赶上末班「校园班车」，只好冒雨走回去。

collocations: the shuttle stops at the dorms

words.enDefinition: travel to campus by bicycle

examples.en: I bike to campus when the weather is nice and lock up by the gym.
examples.zh: 天气好的时候我就「骑车去学校」，把车锁在健身房旁边。

examples.en: It takes me fifteen minutes to bike to school along the river path.
examples.zh: 沿着河边小路「骑车上学」，我只要十五分钟。

words.enDefinition: walking rather than riding or driving

examples.en: My apartment is close, so I go everywhere on foot.
examples.zh: 我住得近，去哪儿都靠「步行」。

examples.en: It takes about half an hour on foot from the dorm to the station.
examples.zh: 从宿舍到车站，「步行」大概要半个小时。

words.enDefinition: drive a person somewhere in your car

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to campus? My bike has a flat tire.
examples.zh: 能「开车送我一程」去学校吗？我的自行车爆胎了。

examples.en: My neighbor offered to give us a ride to the airport on Sunday.
examples.zh: 邻居主动提出周日「开车送我们」去机场。

collocations: offer to give someone a ride

words.enDefinition: unable to move because the roads are crowded

examples.en: Sorry I'm late, I was stuck in traffic on the bridge for an hour.
examples.zh: 抱歉我迟到了，我在桥上「堵了一个小时」。

examples.en: Leave early, because you never know when you'll get stuck in traffic.
examples.zh: 早点出门吧，谁知道什么时候会「堵在路上」。

collocations: stuck in traffic for an hour

words.enDefinition: go early to avoid the busiest travel time

examples.en: I leave at seven to beat the rush and get a seat on the bus.
examples.zh: 我七点就出门「避开高峰」，还能在公交上抢到座位。

examples.en: Grab lunch at eleven thirty to beat the rush at the dining hall.
examples.zh: 十一点半就去食堂吃饭，「避开排队高峰」。

collocations: leave early to beat the rush

words.enDefinition: moving or doing things quickly because time is short

examples.en: I was in a hurry this morning and forgot my laptop charger.
examples.zh: 今天早上我「急匆匆的」，忘了带电脑充电器。

examples.en: When you're in a hurry, always check that you have your keys.
examples.zh: 「赶时间」的时候，一定要检查钥匙带没带。

collocations: in too much of a hurry

words.enDefinition: leave home very fast because you are late

examples.en: I rushed out the door without breakfast and bought a bagel on campus.
examples.zh: 我「冲出家门」，早餐都没吃，到学校才买了贝果。

examples.en: Don't rush out the door; double-check that you have your student ID.
examples.zh: 别急着「冲出门」，再检查一下学生证带没带。

collocations: rushed out the door without breakfast
about to rush out the door

words.enDefinition: regular jobs you do to keep a home clean

examples.en: My roommate and I split the household chores on a whiteboard schedule.
examples.zh: 我和室友用白板排班，「分摊家务活」。

examples.en: Doing household chores on Sunday makes the whole week feel calmer.
examples.zh: 周日做点「家务活」，整周都会觉得清爽些。

words.enDefinition: cleaning and organizing jobs done at home

examples.en: I catch up on housework while listening to my favorite podcast.
examples.zh: 我一边听喜欢的播客，一边做点「家务事」。

examples.en: We agreed to do our housework before friends come over on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们说好周五朋友来之前把「家务」做完。

words.enDefinition: divide housework fairly between roommates or family

examples.en: Let's split the chores: I'll take the bathroom, you take the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 我们「分摊家务」吧：我负责浴室，你负责厨房地板。

examples.en: We split the chores fairly, so nobody feels like the housekeeper.
examples.zh: 我们公平地「分摊家务」，没人觉得自己像保姆。

words.enDefinition: do the part of the work that is your responsibility

examples.en: If you do your share, cleaning the apartment takes half an hour.
examples.zh: 只要人人都「做好分内事」，打扫公寓半小时就够了。

examples.en: We all do our share around here, so nobody complains.
examples.zh: 在这儿大家都「做好分内事」，所以没人抱怨。

collocations: do your share of the chores

words.enDefinition: do something one after another in order

examples.en: My roommate and I take turns taking out the trash every week.
examples.zh: 我和室友每周「轮流」倒垃圾。

examples.en: We took turns doing the dishes so it felt fair to both of us.
examples.zh: 我们「轮流」洗碗，这样对两个人都公平。

words.enDefinition: make a room tidy by putting things in place

examples.en: I straighten up my desk every evening so mornings feel less chaotic.
examples.zh: 我每天晚上都会把书桌「收拾整齐」，早上就不会乱糟糟。

examples.en: Let's straighten up the living room before the study group arrives.
examples.zh: 学习小组来之前，我们把客厅「收拾一下吧」。

words.enDefinition: clean dust off the floor with a broom

examples.en: Please sweep the floor after you trim your hair in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 你在卫生间剪完头发之后，记得「扫地」。

examples.en: I swept the floor twice this week; it keeps getting sandy.
examples.zh: 这周我已经「扫了两遍地」，还是总感觉有沙子。

collocations: sweep the floor with a broom

words.enDefinition: wash the floor with a wet mop

examples.en: After we mopped the floor, the whole apartment smelled clean.
examples.zh: 我们「拖完地」，整个公寓闻起来都很清爽。

examples.en: Mop the floor last so you don't walk over it with dirty shoes.
examples.zh: 「拖地」要放在最后做，免得又被踩脏了。

collocations: mop the floor with hot water
mop the floor once a week

words.enDefinition: a soft clump of dust found under furniture

examples.en: There are dust bunnies under my bed the size of small animals.
examples.zh: 我床底下的「灰尘团」大得像小动物。

examples.en: Move the dresser when you clean, or the dust bunnies will stay hidden.
examples.zh: 打扫时把柜子挪开，不然「灰尘团」会一直藏在那儿。

words.enDefinition: clean a place very thoroughly, beyond the usual routine

examples.en: We gave the apartment a deep clean before the landlord's inspection.
examples.zh: 房东来检查之前，我们给公寓做了一次「深度大扫除」。

examples.en: Sunday is my deep clean day for the bathroom and closet.
examples.zh: 周日是我的「深度打扫日」，专攻浴室和衣柜。

collocations: give the place a deep clean

words.enDefinition: thorough cleaning of a home, traditionally done in spring

examples.en: I'm doing some spring cleaning and found clothes I forgot I owned.
examples.zh: 我在做「春季大扫除」，翻出了自己都忘了的衣服。

examples.en: Our dorm tradition is a big spring cleaning right after finals week.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍的传统是期末周一结束就来一场「春季大扫除」。

words.enDefinition: scrub and tidy the shared bathroom as a chore

examples.en: It's my turn to clean the bathroom, so I bought new sponges.
examples.zh: 这周轮到我「清洁浴室」，所以我买了新海绵。

examples.en: We clean the bathroom every Saturday morning before anyone takes a shower.
examples.zh: 我们每周六早上在大家洗澡之前「打扫浴室」。

collocations: my turn to clean the bathroom

words.enDefinition: products and tools used for cleaning the home

examples.en: We split the cost of cleaning supplies and keep them by the door.
examples.zh: 「清洁用品」我们平摊费用，就放在门口。

examples.en: The campus store sells basic cleaning supplies like sponges and spray.
examples.zh: 校园超市有卖海绵、喷剂这类基础的「清洁用品」。

collocations: a closet full of cleaning supplies

words.enDefinition: leave a place dirty or untidy after an activity

examples.en: I always make a mess when I dye my hair in the sink.
examples.zh: 我在水池边染头发的时候总会「弄得乱糟糟」。

examples.en: If you make a mess in the common room, please clean it up right away.
examples.zh: 如果你把公共休息室「弄乱了」，请立刻清理干净。

collocations: make a mess of the kitchen

words.enDefinition: put fresh, clean sheets on the bed

examples.en: I change the sheets every two weeks and wash them right away.
examples.zh: 我每两周「换一次床单」，换下来马上就洗。

examples.en: Fresh sheets feel amazing, so I changed the sheets before my parents visited.
examples.zh: 干净床单太舒服了，爸妈来之前我特意「换了床单」。

words.enDefinition: the fixed weekday when trash is collected on your street

examples.en: Tomorrow is garbage day, so take the bins out tonight.
examples.zh: 明天是「收垃圾日」，今晚就把垃圾桶搬出去。

examples.en: I always forget whether garbage day is Tuesday or Wednesday on this street.
examples.zh: 我总记不住这条街的「垃圾日」是周二还是周三。

collocations: take the bins out on garbage day

words.enDefinition: go and see what letters or packages have arrived

examples.en: I check the mail downstairs every evening after my last class.
examples.zh: 每天最后一节课之后，我都会下楼「取邮件」。

examples.en: Can you check the mail on your way in? My textbook should be there.
examples.zh: 你进来时能顺便「看看信箱」吗？我的教材应该到了。

collocations: check the mail on the way in

words.enDefinition: give the family or roommate's dog its food

examples.en: I feed the dog at seven, then take her for a quick walk.
examples.zh: 我七点「喂狗」，然后带她出去遛一小圈。

examples.en: Who was supposed to feed the dog while I was on the trip?
examples.zh: 我出差的时候本来该谁「喂狗」的？

collocations: feed the dog twice a day

words.enDefinition: the day each week when you wash your clothes

examples.en: Sunday is laundry day, and the basement machines fill up fast.
examples.zh: 周日是「洗衣日」，地下室的洗衣机很快就排满了。

examples.en: I push laundry day to Saturday when I run out of clean shirts.
examples.zh: 等干净衬衫穿完了，我就把「洗衣日」拖到周六。

words.enDefinition: one machine full of clothes to be washed

examples.en: Throw in a load of laundry before we head to the library.
examples.zh: 出发去图书馆之前，先「洗一机衣服」。

examples.en: One load of laundry costs two dollars in the dorm basement.
examples.zh: 在宿舍地下室，「洗一机衣服」要两美元。

collocations: throw in a load of laundry
a load of whites and a load of colors

words.enDefinition: the washing pattern you select on a laundry machine

examples.en: Choose the gentle wash cycle for sweaters and gym clothes.
examples.zh: 毛衣和运动服要选「轻柔洗涤程序」。

examples.en: This old machine's normal wash cycle takes almost an hour.
examples.zh: 这台旧机器的标准「洗涤程序」要将近一个小时。

words.enDefinition: the fast spinning part that removes water from clothes

examples.en: The spin cycle is so loud in our basement that it shakes the walls.
examples.zh: 地下室的「脱水程序」声音大得能震墙。

examples.en: Add an extra spin cycle if the jeans come out still dripping.
examples.zh: 如果牛仔裤拿出来还在滴水，就再加一次「脱水」。

words.enDefinition: wash clothes gently by hand in a basin

examples.en: I hand-wash my wool sweater in the sink with a little shampoo.
examples.zh: 我用一点洗发水在水槽里「手洗」羊毛衫。

examples.en: Hand-wash the silk blouse, or it will stretch out of shape.
examples.zh: 那件真丝衬衫要「手洗」，不然会变形。

words.enDefinition: fragile clothes like silk or lace that need gentle washing

examples.en: Put your delicates in a mesh bag so the straps don't tangle.
examples.zh: 把「细软衣物」放进洗衣袋，免得肩带缠在一起。

examples.en: The care label says to wash delicates separately in cold water.
examples.zh: 洗涤标签说，「细软衣物」要用冷水单独洗。

words.enDefinition: the sewn-in tag with washing instructions on clothes

examples.en: Always read the care label inside the collar before you bleach anything.
examples.zh: 漂白任何衣物之前，先读一下领口内侧的「洗涤标签」。

examples.en: The care label on my sweater says hand-wash only in cold water.
examples.zh: 我毛衣的「洗涤标签」写着只能用冷水手洗。

collocations: the care label says hand-wash only

words.enDefinition: a strong liquid that whitens clothes and kills stains

examples.en: Add a little bleach to the white load to keep the socks bright.
examples.zh: 洗白色衣物时加点「漂白剂」，袜子才能保持亮白。

examples.en: Careful with bleach in the laundry room; it splashes on colored clothes.
examples.zh: 在洗衣房用「漂白剂」要小心，会溅到有色的衣服上。

words.enDefinition: a product you apply to spots before washing

examples.en: Dab some stain remover on the coffee spot before it dries.
examples.zh: 趁咖啡渍还没干，赶紧涂点「去渍剂」。

examples.en: A travel-size stain remover lives in my backpack for emergencies.
examples.zh: 我背包里常备一支旅行装的「去渍剂」应急。

collocations: apply stain remover to the spot

words.enDefinition: become smaller in size after being washed or dried

examples.en: My favorite sweater shrank two sizes in the hot dryer.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的毛衣在热烘干机里「缩了」两码。

examples.en: Wash cotton in cold water so it doesn't shrink in the machine.
examples.zh: 棉质的要用冷水洗，免得在机器里「缩水」。

collocations: washed it hot and it shrank

words.enDefinition: let wet clothes dry naturally on a rack or line

examples.en: I air dry my sweaters on the rack instead of using the dryer.
examples.zh: 毛衣我都放架子上「晾干」，不用烘干机。

examples.en: Air dry your jeans overnight and they will keep their shape.
examples.zh: 牛仔裤「晾」一晚上，版型就不会变。

collocations: air dry sweaters on a rack
air dry instead of tumble drying

words.enDefinition: twist wet cloth tightly to squeeze out water

examples.en: Wring out the mop before you lean it against the wall.
examples.zh: 拖把先「拧干」了，再靠到墙边。

examples.en: She wrung out her soaked socks over the bathtub after the rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴雨过后，她在浴缸上方「拧干」湿透的袜子。

collocations: wring it out over the sink

words.enDefinition: professional cleaning of clothes without water

examples.en: My blazer needs dry cleaning before the career fair next week.
examples.zh: 下周招聘会之前，我的西装外套得送去「干洗」。

examples.en: There's a dry cleaning shop two blocks from the east gate.
examples.zh: 东门外两个街区有一家「干洗店」。

words.enDefinition: a tag warning that water will ruin the garment

examples.en: That wool coat says dry clean only, so don't toss it in the machine.
examples.zh: 那件羊毛大衣标着「只能干洗」，别扔进洗衣机。

examples.en: I ignore the dry clean only label and hand-wash it very gently.
examples.zh: 我没理会「只可干洗」的标签，非常轻柔地手洗了它。

collocations: ignore the dry clean only tag

words.enDefinition: liquid soap made for washing your body in the shower

examples.en: The communal shower has a shelf where you can keep your body wash.
examples.zh: 公共淋浴间有个架子，可以放你的「沐浴露」。

examples.en: I bought a big bottle of body wash at the drugstore for eight dollars.
examples.zh: 我在药妆店花八美元买了一大瓶「沐浴露」。

words.enDefinition: wash yourself by sitting in a tub of water

examples.en: After a week of exams, I just want to take a hot bath.
examples.zh: 考完一整周的试，我只想「泡个热水澡」。

examples.en: Most dorms only have showers, so I take a bath when I visit home.
examples.zh: 宿舍大多只有淋浴，所以我回家时才「泡澡」。

collocations: take a hot bath before bed

words.enDefinition: remove water from your body or hair with a towel

examples.en: Dry off completely with a towel before you put on clean clothes.
examples.zh: 用毛巾把身体「擦干」，再换上干净衣服。

examples.en: He dried off his hair in front of the shared bathroom heater.
examples.zh: 他在公共浴室的取暖器前「把头发擦干」。

words.enDefinition: flat open sandals held by a strap between the toes

examples.en: Wear flip-flops in the communal shower instead of walking barefoot.
examples.zh: 公共淋浴间里要「穿人字拖」，别光脚走。

examples.en: I keep a pair of flip-flops by the dorm bathroom door.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍卫生间门口放了「一双人字拖」。

words.enDefinition: having an old, damp, unpleasant smell

examples.en: Leave the towel on the rack, or it gets musty in the pile.
examples.zh: 毛巾用完放架子上，堆在一起会「有霉味」。

examples.en: The laundry left in the machine overnight smells musty now.
examples.zh: 忘在洗衣机里过夜的衣服，现在「一股霉味」。

words.enDefinition: clean your hair with shampoo and water

examples.en: I wash my hair every other day to keep it from drying out.
examples.zh: 我「隔天洗一次头」，免得头发太干。

examples.en: Wash your hair tonight so it's dry in time for the morning class.
examples.zh: 今晚就把头「洗了」，明早上课前才来得及干。

collocations: wash my hair every other day
too lazy to wash my hair

words.enDefinition: clean your hands with soap and water

examples.en: Wash your hands for twenty seconds after you get home.
examples.zh: 到家之后要「洗手」至少二十秒。

examples.en: I always wash my hands before I start cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 开始做晚饭之前，我总会先「洗手」。

words.enDefinition: clothes that have been washed and are ready to wear

examples.en: I'm down to my last clean clothes, so laundry day is tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我的「干净衣服」只剩最后几件了，明天就是洗衣日。

examples.en: Pack a week of clean clothes for the conference trip.
examples.zh: 出差开会要带够一周的「干净衣服」。

words.enDefinition: get into bed to sleep at night

examples.en: I try to go to bed before midnight on school nights.
examples.zh: 有课的日子，我尽量十二点前「上床睡觉」。

examples.en: She went to bed at two and still made her eight a.m. lecture.
examples.zh: 她两点才「睡」，居然还赶上了早八的课。

collocations: go to bed at the same time every night

words.enDefinition: do the last small tasks before sleeping

examples.en: I get ready for bed around eleven: brush my teeth, set alarms, dim the lights.
examples.zh: 我十一点左右「准备睡觉」：刷牙、定闹钟、把灯调暗。

examples.en: Put your phone away when you get ready for bed to sleep faster.
examples.zh: 「准备睡觉」的时候把手机收起来，入睡更快。

collocations: get ready for bed and wind down

words.enDefinition: the calming habits you repeat before sleeping

examples.en: My bedtime routine is a shower, some light reading, then lights out.
examples.zh: 我的「睡前流程」是洗澡、看点轻松的书，然后熄灯。

examples.en: A steady bedtime routine helps me fall asleep without scrolling.
examples.zh: 固定的「睡前流程」让我不刷手机也能睡着。

words.enDefinition: slowly relax after a busy day before sleeping

examples.en: I wind down with ten minutes of stretching before I sleep.
examples.zh: 睡前我会做十分钟拉伸来「放松」。

examples.en: She winds down by journaling instead of scrolling her phone in bed.
examples.zh: 她靠写日记「放松」，而不是躺在床上刷手机。

collocations: wind down after a long day

words.enDefinition: sit back and rest after working hard

examples.en: After moving boxes all afternoon, I put my feet up with a show.
examples.zh: 搬了一下午箱子，我「歇着脚」看了会儿剧。

examples.en: Put your feet up for ten minutes, then we'll clean the kitchen.
examples.zh: 先「歇十分钟」，然后我们再收拾厨房。

collocations: put my feet up on the couch
sit down and put your feet up
put my feet up after class

words.enDefinition: sit or lie with your body drawn into a ball

examples.en: On rainy Sundays I curl up on the couch with a novel.
examples.zh: 下雨的周日，我就「窝在沙发上」看小说。

examples.en: The cat curled up on my clean laundry the second I left.
examples.zh: 我刚一走，猫就「蜷在」我刚洗好的衣服上。

collocations: curl up with a good book

words.enDefinition: someone who sits watching TV for hours

examples.en: During winter break I turn into a total couch potato.
examples.zh: 寒假一到，我就彻底成了「整天窝在沙发的人」。

examples.en: Stop being a couch potato and come to the gym with us.
examples.zh: 别做「整天窝在沙发的人」了，跟我们去健身房吧。

words.enDefinition: spend time relaxing with nothing to do

examples.en: I laze around the apartment until noon on lazy Saturdays.
examples.zh: 悠闲的周六，我在公寓里「慵懒地闲待着」，一直到中午。

examples.en: We lazed around the dorm all day instead of doing our chores.
examples.zh: 我们「慵懒地闲待了」一整天，家务活全没做。

words.enDefinition: relax completely, often watching TV and doing nothing

examples.en: After finals I just vegged out in front of the TV for three days.
examples.zh: 期末结束后，我「彻底躺平放松」，看了三天电视。

examples.en: Let's veg out tonight and start cleaning the apartment tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今晚咱们先「躺平放松」，打扫明天再说。

collocations: veg out in front of the TV

words.enDefinition: remain at home instead of going out socially

examples.en: I'm staying in tonight to catch up on my laundry and sleep.
examples.zh: 今晚我「待在家里」，补一下洗衣和睡眠。

examples.en: We stayed in and watched movies instead of going to the party.
examples.zh: 我们「待在家里」看电影，没去派对。

words.enDefinition: remain outside home until very late at night

examples.en: We stayed out late celebrating her birthday and regretted it at 8 a.m. class.
examples.zh: 我们庆祝她生日「在外面玩到很晚」，早八的课真是后悔。

examples.en: Don't stay out late tonight; the last subway leaves at midnight.
examples.zh: 今晚别「在外面待到很晚」，末班地铁十二点就发车。

collocations: never stay out late on weekdays

words.enDefinition: a day when you have no work or classes

examples.en: With no classes on Friday, I finally have a day off.
examples.zh: 周五没课，我终于有了一个「休息日」。

examples.en: Use your day off to clean the room, not to sleep until three.
examples.zh: 「休息日」用来打扫房间吧，别一觉睡到下午三点。

words.enDefinition: a short daytime sleep that restores energy quickly

examples.en: A twenty-minute power nap between lectures keeps me sharp all afternoon.
examples.zh: 两节课之间「小憩」二十分钟，一下午都精神。

examples.en: Set an alarm so your power nap doesn't turn into two hours.
examples.zh: 设个闹钟，别让「小憩」变成两小时的大睡。

words.enDefinition: relax or sleep a little to recover energy

examples.en: You look exhausted; go get some rest before tonight's review session.
examples.zh: 你看起来累坏了，去「休息一会儿」，晚上还有复习课呢。

examples.en: Get some rest this weekend so you're fresh for the presentation.
examples.zh: 周末「好好休息」，下周展示才能有精神。

words.enDefinition: get some sleep, said in a casual, funny way

examples.en: I need to grab some shut-eye before my midnight library shift.
examples.zh: 去图书馆值夜班之前，我得先「眯一会儿」。

examples.en: Turn off the lights and get some shut-eye; tomorrow starts early.
examples.zh: 关灯「睡一会儿」吧，明天一早就要出门。

collocations: need some shut-eye before the exam

words.enDefinition: fall asleep slowly without noticing it

examples.en: I drifted off during the last episode and missed the ending.
examples.zh: 最后一集我「迷迷糊糊睡着了」，错过了结局。

examples.en: He drifted off on the bus and nearly missed his stop again.
examples.zh: 他在公交上「迷迷糊糊睡着」，差点又坐过站。

collocations: almost drifted off on the bus

words.enDefinition: fall asleep very quickly and deeply

examples.en: My head hit the pillow and I was out like a light.
examples.zh: 头一碰到枕头，我立刻「睡得不省人事」。

examples.en: After the eighteen-hour flight she was out like a light by nine.
examples.zh: 飞了十八个小时，她九点就「沾床睡熟了」。

collocations: out like a light by ten
hit the pillow and was out like a light

words.enDefinition: sleep very deeply without waking at all

examples.en: I slept like a log and didn't even hear the fire drill.
examples.zh: 我「睡得很死」，连消防演习都没听见。

examples.en: After moving boxes all day, you will sleep like a log tonight.
examples.zh: 搬了一天箱子，今晚你准会「睡得特别沉」。

collocations: sleep like a log after exams
so tired I slept like a log

words.enDefinition: sleeping deeply and peacefully

examples.en: My roommate was sound asleep, so I tiptoed in with the lights off.
examples.zh: 室友「睡得正香」，我关着灯踮脚进去的。

examples.en: Don't call him at noon; he's usually sound asleep after his night shift.
examples.zh: 中午别给他打电话，上完夜班的他通常「睡得正香」。

words.enDefinition: keep moving in bed because you cannot sleep

examples.en: I tossed and turned all night before the results came out.
examples.zh: 出成绩前那晚，我「翻来覆去」睡不着。

examples.en: Coffee after four p.m. makes me toss and turn until two.
examples.zh: 下午四点以后喝咖啡，我会「翻来覆去」到凌晨两点。

words.enDefinition: stay in bed without sleeping, often thinking or worrying

examples.en: I lay awake for two hours worrying about my scholarship interview.
examples.zh: 因为担心奖学金面试，我「躺着睡不着」，睁眼躺了两个小时。

examples.en: She lies awake replaying every awkward thing she said at the party.
examples.zh: 她「躺着睡不着」，把派对上说的每句尴尬话都回放一遍。

words.enDefinition: continue sleeping without being woken by noise

examples.en: I slept through the fire alarm and my roommate had to shake me.
examples.zh: 火警响了我都「睡着没被吵醒」，室友只好把我摇醒。

examples.en: He can sleep through construction noise right outside his window.
examples.zh: 窗外施工他都能「照睡不误」。

words.enDefinition: not having had enough sleep for a long time

examples.en: Everyone in the library looks tired and sleep-deprived during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周图书馆里的每个人看起来又累又「睡眠不足」。

examples.en: Sleep-deprived students often make careless mistakes on easy exam questions.
examples.zh: 「睡眠不足」的学生常在简单的考试题上犯低级错误。

words.enDefinition: a night spent unable to sleep at all

examples.en: I had a sleepless night before the organic chemistry midterm.
examples.zh: 有机化学期中考试前一晚，我一夜「没合眼」。

examples.en: One more sleepless night and I'll start napping in lectures again.
examples.zh: 再来一个「不眠之夜」，我又要开始在课堂上打盹了。

collocations: a sleepless night before the exam

words.enDefinition: often find it hard to fall or stay asleep

examples.en: I've been having trouble sleeping since I started late-night gaming.
examples.zh: 自从开始深夜打游戏，我一直「睡不好」。

examples.en: Drink less bubble tea if you have trouble sleeping at night.
examples.zh: 如果晚上「睡不好」，就少喝点奶茶。

words.enDefinition: someone who wakes up at the smallest noise

examples.en: As a light sleeper, I always pack earplugs for dorm life.
examples.zh: 我「睡觉轻」，住宿舍总是自带耳塞。

examples.en: A light sleeper should face the wall, away from the door.
examples.zh: 「睡觉轻的人」最好朝墙睡，别朝着门。

words.enDefinition: someone who sleeps deeply and is hard to wake

examples.en: My roommate is such a heavy sleeper that alarms don't wake him.
examples.zh: 我室友「睡得特别沉」，闹钟都叫不醒他。

examples.en: As a heavy sleeper, I need three alarms across the room.
examples.zh: 我「睡得沉」，得在房间另一头放三个闹钟。

words.enDefinition: loose comfortable clothes worn for sleeping

examples.en: I answer the door in pajamas and my roommate laughs at me.
examples.zh: 我穿着「睡衣」就去开门，室友都笑了。

examples.en: Some morning lectures are casual enough that students show up in pajamas.
examples.zh: 有的早课氛围很随意，学生「穿着睡衣」就来了。

words.enDefinition: the body's internal timing system for sleep and wakefulness

examples.en: My body clock still thinks it's Beijing time two weeks after landing.
examples.zh: 落地两周了，我的「生物钟」还以为是北京时间。

examples.en: Fix your body clock by waking up at the same hour every day.
examples.zh: 每天同一时间起床，就能把「生物钟」调回来。

collocations: body clock adjusts to a new time zone

words.enDefinition: the fixed times you go to sleep and wake up

examples.en: My sleep schedule fell apart during the group project week.
examples.zh: 小组作业那一周，我的「作息」全乱了。

examples.en: A fixed sleep schedule matters more than sleeping eight hours once.
examples.zh: 固定的「作息时间」比偶尔睡够八小时更重要。

words.enDefinition: sleep extra hours to recover lost sleep

examples.en: I plan to catch up on sleep this weekend after finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周过后，我打算这周末好好「补觉」。

examples.en: You can't fully catch up on sleep by sleeping until noon once.
examples.zh: 光靠某一天睡到中午，「补觉」是补不回来的。

collocations: catch up on sleep on weekends
try to catch up on sleep
catching up on sleep after finals

words.enDefinition: go to bed, said in a casual humorous way

examples.en: I'm exhausted, so I'm going to hit the sack right after this.
examples.zh: 我累坏了，弄完这个就「上床睡觉」。

examples.en: It's almost midnight; time to hit the sack before my early class.
examples.zh: 快十二点了，明早有课，该「睡觉去」了。

words.enDefinition: stop an evening activity and go home to sleep

examples.en: We finished the practice problems and called it a night at midnight.
examples.zh: 我们把练习题做完，午夜「收工睡觉」。

examples.en: It's late and the library is closing, so let's call it a night.
examples.zh: 很晚了，图书馆也要闭馆了，今晚「就到这儿吧」。

collocations: call it a night at midnight
decided to call it a night

words.enDefinition: start moving or working faster right now

examples.en: It's seven thirty already; we'd better get moving or we'll miss the shuttle.
examples.zh: 已经七点半了，我们得「赶紧动起来」，不然赶不上班车。

examples.en: A quick shower helps me get moving on cold winter mornings.
examples.zh: 冬天早上，冲个快速的澡能让我「清醒过来」。

collocations: get moving or we'll be late

words.enDefinition: an evening when you go to bed earlier than usual

examples.en: I'm having an early night so I'm fresh for the morning quiz.
examples.zh: 今晚我要「早点睡」，明早的小测才有精神。

examples.en: After three late nights, even my roommate suggested an early night.
examples.zh: 熬了三晚之后，连我室友都提议「今晚早睡」。

collocations: an early night before the exam

words.enDefinition: later than the time you usually go to sleep

examples.en: It's way past my bedtime, but this novel is too good to stop.
examples.zh: 早就「过了我平时睡觉的点」，可这本小说实在停不下来。

examples.en: One more episode and I'm past my bedtime for sure.
examples.zh: 再看一集，我就真的「超过睡觉时间」了。

collocations: stay up way past my bedtime

words.enDefinition: new energy that appears when you felt tired

examples.en: I got a second wind around eleven and finished the essay.
examples.zh: 十一点左右我「又来了精神」，把论文写完了。

examples.en: Cleaning got a second wind when we put on some music.
examples.zh: 放起音乐之后，我们打扫的劲头「又上来了」。

words.enDefinition: sleep well for a full night and feel restored

examples.en: Turn off screens early if you want to get a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 想「睡个好觉」，就早点关掉屏幕。

examples.en: I can't get a good night's sleep when my roommate games till three.
examples.zh: 室友打游戏打到三点，我没法「睡个好觉」。

collocations: get a good night's sleep before the exam
a good night's sleep helps memory

words.enDefinition: a frightening dream during sleep

examples.en: I had a nightmare about sleeping through my final exam.
examples.zh: 我做了个「噩梦」，梦见自己睡过了期末考试。

examples.en: Eating snacks right before bed gives me weird dreams and nightmares.
examples.zh: 睡前吃零食会让我做怪梦和「噩梦」。

words.enDefinition: breathe noisily through the nose while sleeping

examples.en: My roommate snores so loudly that I sleep with earplugs now.
examples.zh: 我室友「打鼾」太响，我现在都戴着耳塞睡。

examples.en: He only snores when he sleeps flat on his back.
examples.zh: 他只有平躺着睡才会「打呼噜」。

words.enDefinition: leave the house and walk for exercise or air

examples.en: When I can't sleep, I go for a walk around the block.
examples.zh: 睡不着的时候，我就出门「绕街区走走」。

examples.en: Let's go for a walk after dinner instead of watching shows all night.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们「出去走走」吧，别一晚上都刷剧。

collocations: go for a walk after dinner
go for a walk to clear my head
go for a walk around campus

words.enDefinition: go outside briefly for fresh air

examples.en: The room feels stuffy; let's open a window and get some air.
examples.zh: 屋里太闷了，开个窗「透透气」吧。

examples.en: I stepped onto the balcony to get some air between study sessions.
examples.zh: 两轮学习之间，我到阳台「透了透气」。

collocations: step outside to get some air

words.enDefinition: stand at the stop until the bus arrives

examples.en: I wait for the bus at the stop nearest the dining hall.
examples.zh: 我在离食堂最近的站台「等公交」。

examples.en: Waiting for the bus in January without gloves is a mistake.
examples.zh: 一月里不戴手套「等公交」是个错误。

collocations: wait for the bus at the stop
a long wait for the bus
wait for the bus in the rain
